_upstream.body_excerpt:
Refresh cloud plugin and skill catalogs during step preparation

## Why

Installing a plugin without connector tools must still refresh a cached cloud skill catalog so its skills are visible to the next inference.

## What changed

- Rely on step preparation for cloud plugin and skill discovery, removing their turn-start callbacks and the `requires_mcp_runtime` lifecycle hook.
- Request an MCP runtime refresh after every completed plugin install, including skills-only installs.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for skills becoming visible immediately after a connector-free install. Update lifecycle tests to cover discovery after MCP reconciliation, prewarm skipping discovery, cancellation allowing subsequent preparation, and reuse of unchanged connections. Use deterministic DNS lookups in network proxy authorization tests.
